text:
```yaml
name: Regenerate Translations

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'lib/l10n/*.arb'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'lib/l10n/*.arb'

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  regenerate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: stable
          channel: stable

      - name: Install Dart dependencies
        run: flutter pub get

      - name: Activate intl_utils
        run: flutter pub global activate intl_utils

      - name: Generate translation files
        run: flutter pub global run intl_utils:generate

      - name: Create Pull Request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: 'chore: regenerate translations'
          branch: regenerate-translations
          title: 'chore: regenerate translations'
          body: |
            Automated regeneration of translation files.
            This PR was generated by the `regenerate-translations.yml` workflow.
          base: main
          delete-branch: true
```
